# toggl-cli invoice minimum billing floor

Invoice billing in toggl-cli uses only completed billable entries. Each entry is rounded up independently to the next 15-minute (900-second) unit, then a minimum of 30 minutes (1800 seconds) is applied per entry before summing by project. Running entries are ignored; missing projects use No Project; totals sort by billed seconds descending then project name alphabetically.
